inlines.v: MU'NIMENT, noun [Latin munimentum, from munio, to fortify.] 1. A fortification of any kind; a strong hold; a place of defense. 2. Support; defense. 3. Record; a writing by which claims and rights are defended or maintained. Termes de la ley.
